Lemma
[Uniform Sobolev and Holder bounds for the pressure] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0098 1. ch29:29.6\group Pressure Estimates

For every $p<\infty $ and $\alpha \in (0,1)$, uniformly for $t\le -1$, \[ \| v(t)\| _{W^{2,p}(S^2)}\le C(p),\qquad \| v(t)\| _{C^{1,\alpha }(S^2)}\le C(\alpha ). \]
